question: Which Indian dancer of the Manipuri style won the Tagore Award for Cultural Harmony in 2014?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajkumar Singhajit Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Rajkumar Singhajit Singh is a renowned Indian dancer and choreographer known for his expertise in the Manipuri dance form.
 
• He was awarded the prestigious Tagore Award for Cultural Harmony in 2014 for his contributions to the preservation and promotion of Manipuri dance.
 
• Singhajit Singh has been instrumental in popularizing the Manipuri dance form both in India and internationally.
 
• He has received numerous accolades and honors for his work, including the Padma Shri in 1986 and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1984.
